Car Accident Lawyer Serving Los Angeles County

Car accident lawyer serving all of Los Angeles County and surrounding counties. Former insurance company trial attorney. No fee unless we win: 323-452-5222.

Call 323-452-5222Free Case Review

Los Angeles County Roads, Los Angeles County Courts

Los Angeles County has some of the most congested freeways in the country, from the 405 and the 101 to the 5, 10, 110, 134, 210, and 710. Crashes here range from low-speed fender benders in stop-and-go traffic to catastrophic freeway collisions.

Prospect Law Group represents car accident victims throughout the county and Southern California. We can meet by phone, by video, or in person wherever you are. Injury lawsuits arising in the county are filed in the Los Angeles County Superior Court, and we know how cases move through it.

A Former Insurance Insider on Your Side

Attorney Vardan Daldumyan worked as an in-house trial attorney for an insurance company before founding Prospect Law Group. He knows how carriers evaluate Los Angeles claims, and how to build a case they take seriously.

Areas We Serve in Los Angeles County

  • Glendale and the Verdugos: Glendale, La Crescenta, Montrose, La Cañada Flintridge
  • San Fernando Valley: Burbank, North Hollywood, Studio City, Van Nuys, Sherman Oaks
  • San Gabriel Valley: Pasadena, Altadena, South Pasadena, Arcadia
  • Northeast and Central LA: Eagle Rock, Highland Park, Los Feliz, Atwater Village, Silver Lake, Hollywood, Downtown
  • Westside and South Bay: Santa Monica, Culver City, West LA, Inglewood, Torrance, Redondo Beach, Manhattan Beach
  • South LA and Gateway Cities: Long Beach, Compton, Downey, Norwalk, Whittier, Lakewood
  • North County: Santa Clarita, Valencia, Palmdale, Lancaster

Surrounding Counties

We also represent people injured in Orange, Ventura, Riverside, and San Bernardino counties. Lemon law clients can be anywhere in California.

Cases We Handle

Car accidents · Uber and Lyft accidents · Truck accidents · Motorcycle accidents · Pedestrian and bicycle accidents · Hit-and-run and uninsured motorist claims

Claims Against Government Agencies

If a Metro bus, a city vehicle, or a dangerous road condition was involved, you generally must file a written government claim within six months. Missing that deadline can end the claim. Call us right away.
